question: What type of climate occurs along the west coast of continents in subtropical latitudes between 30° - 40° latitudes, covering Central California, Central Chile along the coast in South East and South Western Australia?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mediterranean climate**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Mediterranean climate** occurs along the western coasts of continents within **subtropical latitudes**, typically ranging between** 30° and 40° latitudes.**
 
• This climate is evident in regions such as **Central California, Central Chile, and the coastal areas of South-Eastern and South-Western Australia.**
 
• In this climate zone, winters are generally mild and summers are warm, with significant temperature variations among different regions.
 
• Rainfall is irregular, with the majority occurring during the winter months.
 
• Common vegetation in Mediterranean climates includes oaks, olives, citrus fruits, and junipers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Subtropical steppes** are situated in the transitional areas between dry and humid climates, receiving slightly more precipitation than subtropical deserts. This amount is adequate to support sparse grasslands.
 
• **A humid subtropical climate** is characterized by hot, humid summers and cool to mild winters, falling within the temperate category.
 
• **The marine west coast climate** is typically found midway between the tropics and the Arctic or Antarctic regions, typically between 35 and 60 degrees north latitude.
